text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Gulf Arab states will soon launch a project aimed at raising public awarness and helping reduce growing consumption of water and electricity.
- Experts from Gulf Arab states to meet in Bahrain on June 15 to discuss chemical waste problems.
- Qatar urges the United States to relax policies on Iran and Iraq.
- An ambitious scheme is being studied to ease the pressures of electricity consumption by the industrial sector.
- Tunisia hopes for more cooperation with Bahrain on joint projects, former envoy says.
